title: product.category accounting property accounts — income/expense/COGS/stock valuation account chain L3

property_account_income_categ_id.purpose: Income account used when validating a customer invoice

property_account_expense_categ_id.purpose: Expense/COGS account; in Anglo-Saxon perpetual mode recognised at customer invoice

property_account_income_id.purpose: Product-level income override; leave empty to use category

property_account_expense_id.purpose: Product-level expense override; leave empty to use category

property_cost_method.purpose: Costing method for products in this category

property_stock_journal.purpose: Journal for automated stock accounting entries

account_stock_variation_id.purpose: Inventory variation account for periodic closing

removal_strategy_id.purpose: Force removal strategy (FIFO/LIFO/FEFO/closest/least packages) regardless of location

category_tree_inheritance.logic: Iterative walk: categ = self.categ_id; while categ: if categ[field_name]: return it; categ = categ.parent_id
category_tree_inheritance.note: Parent accounts are NOT copied to children; they are consulted dynamically. Stock account fields do NOT use this walk — only income/expense use it.

v19_schema_changes_vs_v16.storage_change: company_dependent fields now use ir.default (not ir.property). get_company_dependent_fallback() reads ir.default via superuser+company context.
v19_schema_changes_vs_v16.new_stock_variation: account.account.account_stock_variation_id — linked on the account record, not set on product.category

l10n_th_status.comment: l10n_th provides only COA, taxes, and tax groups. Category account setup is manual or via company income/expense account propagation.

migration_risk_flags.description: ir.property is replaced by ir.default in v19 for company_dependent fields. Migration scripts must target ir.default table with (model='product.category', field_name, company_id).

property_stock_account_input_categ_id and property_stock_account_output_categ_id do not exist in v19. Data from these fields must be mapped to property_stock_valuation_account_id and the new variation account structure.

Anglo-Saxon perpetual mode changes when the expense/COGS account is hit (at customer invoice, not vendor bill). Thai companies using this mode need correct category expense account pointing to COGS, not general expense.
Three-tier income/expense resolution means missing category configuration silently falls through to company default. All leaf categories must be audited post-migration.
l10n_th has no pre-configured product category accounts. Thai chart of accounts codes must be manually mapped to categories or set at company level before go-live.

key_one_liner: product.category income/expense accounts resolved product→category-tree→company via _get_category_account(); v19 drops input/output categ fields, uses single stock_valuation_account + variation account; storage backend changed from ir.property to ir.default.
